items.t: No clear trend in pollution-sensitive animals in this region (+0.0 points per decade; 185 surveys at 81 sites, 1994–2026; q = 0.36).
Chloride: of 45 sites with long records here, 1 is rising and 0 falling (seasonal Kendall per site, false discovery rate 5% across all 396 sites tested).
Paved and roofed area went from 2.1% in 1985 to 2.7% in 2025 across 2,926 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

139 of 3,059 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 74 for salt or chloride; 373 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
9 of 3,059 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 78 of 79 high-need ones have none.
